pages.text: At Tianyuan City, humans and demon clans jointly defend against demonic tides. Its Merit Hall exchanges border orders, anti-demon pills, Spirit Realm passes, and Wind-Thunder Vessel blueprints. Local aura density is 2x; see faction_species.
pages.title: Tianyuan Garrison

pages.text: Garrison merit and frontier supplies vary with regional events and reputation. The server remains authoritative for every exchange. Source index: patchouli_item_book.static_entries.tianyuan_garrison.
